description:
Take your message everywhere with distinct & durable vinyl stickers.

Vinyl stickers are a cost-effective way of marketing your product. Whether you’re a large company or a mom-and-pop store, stickers can help you get your message across to your target customers.

Unlike digital ads that constantly change, stickers tend to stay for a long time. When displayed, vinyl stickers serve as a personal recommendation or endorsement from your customers. In addition to increased brand exposure, stickers can also serve as standalone products that you can sell.

Ready to do some sticker marketing? We'll take care of your custom printing needs as soon as you select and upload the sticker design. Find out which are the best options for your sticker needs below.

 

Singles or Roll?

How you dispense your stickers depends on your desired outcome. We offer two types of stickers to suit different needs and budgets:

 

Singles (formerly known as cut-to-size): These are individually cut crack-and-peel stickers that make great promotional giveaways or handouts. Minimum order quantity is 25 pieces.

Roll:These are easy-to-peel stickers that are printed on a single roll of white vinyl. They can be hand or machine applied and are ideal to use on different products. The minimum order quantity is 250 pieces.


Roll stickers are easy to peel from the roll by hand or can be applied using a label applicator to ensure precise placement.

Single stickers feature a scored backing to easily crack and peel away the sticker to apply to any surface.

 

Designing an Effective Sticker Artwork

The effectiveness of your sticker marketing campaign depends on a number of things, which include the design of your artwork.
For beautiful artwork that sticks in the mind of customers, consider the following design tips:

 

 

Choose the right size and shape. Use a ruler or tape measure to get the height and width of the surface space. The sticker size should be slightly smaller than this. The shape of the sticker depends on where you want to place the labels. Follow the shape of the packaging when choosing a sticker for your products. If you're going to use the stickers for a specific promotion, you can go with any shape that fits your brand.

Make sure that the material can hold up to your needs. Not all sticker materials are created equal. White vinyl is great for outdoor use because it is water and UV-resistant and can withstand varying temperatures.

Pick colors and fonts that reflect your brand. Light-colored text works best on a dark background and vice versa. Don’t know which colors would work best for your brand? Check out our blog post about color theories to back up your design for inspiration.

Use only high-resolution images. Low-resolution images tend to be blurry when printed on stickers. Sticker images should ideally have a resolution 300 dpi.

Create a bleed for a cleaner look. Extending your background beyond the cut line prevents thin white edges from showing. This is especially useful for single stickers, where cutting machines may show a slight difference in cuts.

 

If you don't have artwork yet, you can use our free design tool in creating beautiful sticker designs. Otherwise, you may send in your files for proofing and we'll ensure our printing services bring out the design in the highest quality.


Vinyl Stickers FAQs

Q: How long do vinyl stickers last?

Vinyl stickers are designed to resist fading from sun exposure, making them durable and long-lasting. They are waterproof and can maintain your message for an extended period. All vinyl stickers are made of high-gloss white vinyl, which is resistant to hot water, regardless of the quantity ordered. 

If you order vinyl stickers above 250 pieces, your stickers will be made of white vinyl high gloss that is also hot water resistant. All other vinyl stickers below this quantity are only waterproof to cold temperatures. 

Q: Can I remove and reuse the vinyl stickers?

No, our vinyl stickers come with a permanent adhesive and are meant for long-term applications. 

Q: Do vinyl stickers stick to anything?

Yes, the stickers stick to most surfaces as long as they are applied on a clean, dry surface at room temperature. 

Q: What is the minimum and maximum quantity, and can I order a custom quantity?

The minimum order quantity is 250 stickers. There is no maximum quantity, andso you can order as many as you need. 

Q: How fast can I get my vinyl stickers?

Vinyl stickers can be produced in as quickly as three (3) business days. Please note that turnaround time does not include weekends, holidays, or shipping time. 

Q: How can I print my own design?

You can upload your own design using our easy-to-use design tool or send us your files for proofing and printing. 

Q: Can I save more when I order in bulk?

Yes, discounts are automatically applied for bulk orders. Check the product page for details. 

Q: Can I order die-cut or custom-shaped stickers?

Yes, you can select from a variety of shapes or request a custom shape from the dropdown menu.

Q: Are the stickers waterproof and safe for outdoor use?

Yes, our vinyl stickers are waterproof and designed to be safe for outdoor use.
